paragraphs.text: Brachyolmia type 4 with mild epiphyseal and metaphyseal changes is an autosomal recessive skeletal dysplasia. It is characterized by short-trunk short stature with normal intelligence. Radiographs show rectangular vertebral bodies or platyspondyly with irregular endplates, narrow intervertebral discs, early calcification of rib cartilage, short femoral necks, and mild epiphyseal and metaphyseal changes of the tubular bones (Ahmad et al., 1998; Miyake et al., 2012). The phenotype ranges from brachyolmia to spondyloepimetaphyseal dysplasia (Miyake et al., 2012).

paragraphs.text: Ahmad et al. (1998) studied an inbred Pakistani kindred spanning 8 generations with a distinct form of spondyloepimetaphyseal dysplasia (SEMD). They evaluated 16 affected individuals, 11 males and 5 females. Clinical findings included short stature evident at birth, short bowed lower limbs, mild brachydactyly, kyphoscoliosis, an abnormal gait, enlarged knee joints, precocious osteoarthropathy, and normal intelligence. Radiographs showed delayed epiphyseal ossification at the hips and knees, platyspondyly with irregular end plates and narrowed joint spaces, diffuse early osteoarthritic changes, mainly in the spine and hands, and mild brachydactyly. Ahmad et al. (1998) considered this phenotype distinct from other autosomal recessive forms of SEMD because of the mild metaphyseal involvement, the type of brachydactyly, and the absence of loose joints or other clinical findings.

paragraphs.text: Miyake et al. (2012) used exon capture and next-generation sequencing in 3 affected members of a Turkish family with autosomal recessive brachyolmia. They identified a homozygous loss-of-function mutation in the PAPSS2 gene, c.337_338insG (p.A113GfsX18). In 3 more patients with similar brachyolmia phenotypes (2 Japanese and 1 Korean), they found other loss-of-function PAPSS2 mutations. One patient was homozygous for IVS3+2delT. The second was compound heterozygous for c.616-634del19 (p.V206SfsX9) and c.1309-1310delAG (p.R437GfsX19). The third was compound heterozygous for c.480_481insCGTA (p.K161RfsX6) and c.661delA (p.I221SfsX40).
